title: •Kuat Drive Yards
caption: •Kuat Drive Yards (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. {ovs} Fear Will Keep Them In Line is canceled. Unique (•) _Imperial_-class Star Destroyers are deploy -1, gain an additional permanent pilot of ability 2, and are immune to attrition < 4. During your deploy phase, may use 2 Force to ▼ a battleground system. {alter}
lore: Company that produces current generation of Star Destroyers, as well as Nebulon-B Frigate. Ship yards are extremely well defended.

notes: Unique. Banner EFFECT, no grabber box. Inline icons: an orange-red sphere (the slip's own Original Virtual set symbol printed inline, as on vs6/29's heading) before 'Fear Will Keep Them In Line' → {ovs} (the stub drops it: 'Fear Will Keep Them In Line is canceled' = the (V) version); 'Imperial' in 'Imperial-class Star Destroyers' is italic on the slip → _Imperial_; the slip prints ▼ where the stub expands 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'; red circle-slash A at the end → {alter}. Lore corrected from scan (350 px base and the 745 px V0 remake agree): 'Nebulon-B Frigate.' singular — the wiki base page has 'Frigates'. Base scan only at 350 px (SE-D-kuatdriveyards.gif); copyright line is the Special Edition form, '1998' read off the scan. Modern: V0-D-kuatdriveyards.gif (745 px); VB4 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
